q1: SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE beer IN (SELECT s.beer FROM serves AS s, frequents AS f WHERE s.bar = f.bar AND f.drinker LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY s.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.bar) >= 2) GROUP BY beer ORDER BY beer
q2: SELECT s.beer AS beer, MAX(s.price) - MIN(s.price) AS price_gap, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price FROM serves AS s INNER JOIN frequents AS f ON s.bar = f.bar WHERE s.beer IN (SELECT s.beer FROM serves AS s INNER JOIN frequents AS f ON s.bar = f.bar WHERE f.drinker LIKE 'B%') GROUP BY s.beer ORDER BY s.beer
